scope: Coordinator-owned actual Godot sampling diagnostic, supplemental to editor native captures; not a change to the game or approval.
engine: Godot4.7.2 stable, OpenGL4.1 Metal compatibility, AppleM4
sample: S, native frame0 of belt-straight-n round08; exact source copy hash in inputs/provenance.json
pipeline: Three actual independent textures at registered pitch vs exact precomposed native-alpha-over image; same Godot SubViewport sampling. Native-cell128 and phone-cell32. Imported PNG default flags and explicit ImageTexture mip-generation tested separately.
interpretation: Existing individually filtered rendering has a measured N/S edge discrepancy at128-cell scale. Imported-texture32-cell S0 is clean in this sample, so this is placement/scale-sensitive. Nearest is not established as a drop-in fix: native Godot128 nearest sampling differs from the nearest precomposed reference. Filtering a correctly precomposed layer is a tested visual comparison; no runtime compositor is implemented. Native asset and actual-use acceptance belong to judge.
artifactPolicy: These test sources/outputs are frozen supplemental evidence. Further experiments use a new folder. Editor handoff hash list covers editor files, not these coordinator additions or packet/delivery snapshot.
